source: Collin County, Texas — Voting Precincts (county GIS), split where a precinct has more than one ballot by the county Cities layer, Texas Education Agency School Districts 2026 and TCEQ Water Districts (Blue Meadow MUD 2 and 4); precinct and sub-precinct ballot styles from the county Elections API
note: Each polygon is a precinct, or the part of a precinct that gets one of its printed ballot styles. Parts where the public boundary layers cannot tell the printed styles apart (Lavon Municipal Development District, The Preserve MUD, Lowry Crossing wards), and precinct 201 (its printed ballot names a different congressional district than the precinct map), show the races on every ballot in the county and the official sample ballot link. Smallest first.
